name: Animation & VFX
title: Animation and VFX
intro: The animation and VFX roadmap: foundations, tools, specialisation, showreel and studio careers.

phases.title: School years: draw and tell stories
phases.summary: Any stream; practise drawing, storytelling and film watching.
points: Animation and VFX courses accept students from any stream.
Practise drawing, sketching and character design.
Watch films and animation critically; study movement and timing.
Try free software like Blender for simple projects.

phases.title: Degree or diploma and entrance
points: NID, IIT design programmes (UCEED) and private institutes offer animation and film design.
Many institutes run their own entrance tests with drawing and aptitude components.
Diploma and certificate courses allow a shorter route.
Check the studio, lab setup and placement history.

phases.title: Fundamentals of animation
phases.summary: Drawing, principles of animation and storytelling.
points: Learn the 12 principles of animation, timing and spacing.
Practise life drawing, anatomy and perspective.
Learn storyboarding and scriptwriting.
Create short 2D animation exercises.

phases.title: Tools and specialisation
phases.summary: Pick a pipeline role and master its tools.
points: 3D modelling and animation with Maya or Blender; texturing with Substance Painter.
VFX and compositing with Nuke or After Effects; effects with Houdini.
2D animation with Toon Boom or TV Paint; motion graphics with After Effects.
Specialise as a modeller, rigger, animator, lighting artist, compositor or VFX artist.
facts: Maya, Blender, Houdini, Nuke, After Effects

phases.title: Showreel, internship and studio jobs
phases.summary: A strong showreel is your key to jobs.
points: Create a 60–90 second showreel of your best work.
Intern at animation and VFX studios in Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad and Chennai.
Apply for junior artist roles in studios, gaming, advertising and OTT content.
Keep upgrading skills: real-time engines like Unreal and Unity are in demand.
